intro.title: Salt & Generic Molecule Substitute Finder
intro.subtitle: Instant bio-equivalent discovery, stock availability check, and customer savings

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 11: Salt and Generic Molecule Substitute Finder. When a prescribed medicine is out of stock or when patients request affordable alternatives, pharmacists can instantly locate bio-equivalent formulations.
In the cart, locate the generic salt name under the medicine title, or press F9. Click the Alt substitute button next to the salt name to open the Therapeutic Alternatives modal.
MediFlow automatically filters available inventory sharing the exact active pharmaceutical ingredient. The finder displays on-hand strip stock, batch numbers, and live retail prices.
Click Select Substitute. MediFlow seamlessly replaces the item in the cart, instantly recalculating tax rates and margins without manual re-entry.
Press F10 to finalize the invoice. In Part 12, learn Promise Orders: capturing patient demand when a medicine is completely out of stock.

outro.takeaway: Substitute Finder (F9): Instantly find and dispense in-stock generic alternatives sharing the exact therapeutic molecule.
